summary: Expand and collapse a region with an animated height that a layout group re-flows around.
overview: Animates a content region open and closed by driving a LayoutElement's preferred height through the tween engine. Because it animates the LAYOUT value rather than the transform, a surrounding VerticalLayoutGroup re-flows around it — which is what makes a FAQ list or a settings category list work.
useCases: FAQ or help sections that expand one at a time.
A details panel that reveals more without a new screen.

params.tuning: Its natural expanded height is captured, so the content must be laid out correctly before the first collapse.
Every frame of the animation re-flows the parent layout, so long durations on a large list are the expensive case.

gotchas.title: It animates layout, not the transform
gotchas.body: That is what lets neighbours move out of the way, and it means the cost is a layout rebuild per frame rather than a cheap position change.
